expirySchema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_batches (
receipt TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_receipts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
lot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(lot)), quantity REAL NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>=0),
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS stock_batches_lot ON stock_batches(lot);
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS stock_batch_queue AS
ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) AS ahead
FROM stock_batches b JOIN stock_receipts r ON r.id=b.receipt WHERE b.quantity>0;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS expiry_receipt_post AFTER UPDATE OF status ON stock_receipts
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS expiry_receipt_edit AFTER UPDATE OF quantity ON stock_receipts
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS expiry_sell AFTER INSERT ON sale_lines BEGIN
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS expiry_move AFTER INSERT ON stock_movements
WHEN NEW.target IS NOT NULL OR NEW.qty<0 BEGIN
WHERE NEW.target IS NOT NULL AND lot=NEW.lot AND ahead<NEW.qty
expiryRows: WITH tracked AS (SELECT lot,sum(quantity) quantity FROM stock_batches GROUP BY lot),
FROM sale_stock s LEFT JOIN tracked t ON t.lot=s.id WHERE s.stock>0)
FROM stock_batches b JOIN remaining s ON s.id=b.lot JOIN stock_receipts r ON r.id=b.receipt
JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=s.warehouse LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=s.productId WHERE round(b.quantity,9)>0
FROM remaining s JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=s.warehouse LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id=s.productId WHERE s.untracked>0
expiryEditWarehouses: WITH batch AS (SELECT r.id,r.warehouse_id FROM stock_receipts r JOIN stock_batches b ON b.receipt=r.id
WHERE r.id=@receipt AND b.lot=@lot AND round(b.quantity,9)>0 AND r.status='posted')
SELECT warehouse_id AS warehouse FROM batch
UNION SELECT json_extract(s.lot,'$[0]') FROM stock_batches s JOIN batch b ON b.id=s.receipt WHERE round(s.quantity,9)>0
expiryUpdate: UPDATE stock_receipts SET expires_on=@expiresOn WHERE id=@receipt AND expires_on IS @previous
invalidStockBatches: SELECT 1 FROM stock_receipts WHERE expires_on IS NOT NULL AND
(length(expires_on)<>10 OR substr(expires_on,1,4)='0000' OR date(expires_on,'+0 days') IS NOT expires_on
OR (status='posted' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_batches b WHERE b.receipt=stock_receipts.id
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM stock_batches b JOIN stock_receipts r ON r.id=b.receipt
WHERE r.status<>'posted' OR json_type(b.lot) IS NOT 'array' OR json_remove(b.lot,'$[0]')
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM stock_batches b LEFT JOIN sale_stock s ON s.id=b.lot
UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM stock_batches b JOIN stock_receipts r ON r.id=b.receipt
GROUP BY b.receipt HAVING round(sum(b.quantity)-r.quantity,9)>0 LIMIT 1
